desc: Derive the exact cost formula for converting a subarray into a non-decreasing array using only increments.
Derive and rigorously validate the amortized-O(n) monotonic-block deque.
Run sample tests and exhaustive brute-force validation of the implementation, including equal values, cascading merges, and suffix removals after merges.
Prove two-pointer endpoint monotonicity and that the counting formula counts every valid subarray exactly once.
Check numerical bounds, imports, signature compliance, and final code format.
